introduction: Explore the brimstone mines, recover three overseer lockets, and follow the forge and prison key stories.
orientation: Two cave entrances connect the mines with the Cave of the Roc and a destroyed shop. Search the mines for hidden cracks; finding a passage and crossing it are different steps.
Ask the traveling efreeti hello in the entrance cavern. Hi, hey and howdy are alternate greetings for the same conversation lead.
Three illithid overseers wear three different lockets. Gather the first, second and third lockets and carry the entire set loose before offering one to the efreeti.
The efreeti exchange gives a wand of fiery power, experience and an ethereal key. Its response is currently empty; the accepted exchange is still recorded.
The ethereal key fits the eastern door into the forge and is fragile. The forge’s northern portcullis has an unresolved key reference; deeper access needs builder review.
The Minotaur general carries the large key for the eastern prison cell. The ethereal guardian exchanges an ancient arcane rune for a mithril key for the northern cell.

The rune and the barracks chest key have no declared source in the reviewed stock. The southern prison door also has a mismatched key reference. These are unfinished builder leads, not completed journal steps.
The rune return accepts a supplied exact rune without remembered efreeti completion or personal source battles. Current item checklists differ from accepted quest history after the items are spent.

Mine workers, slavemasters, spectres, Kaynor, the Chronomancer’s child and Azurael offer wider encounter stories. Cleansing, liberation, rescue, weapon effects and shared door access need their own defined outcomes.

contacts.name: an illithid overseer
contacts.description: Three overseers wear different lockets in different mine caverns. Recover the first, second and third lockets; three copies of one locket do not make the set.

contacts.name: a traveling Efreeti
contacts.description: Ask hello to learn about the three lockets. Carry all three loose together, then offer one to complete the set for the fiery wand, experience and ethereal key.

contacts.name: an ethereal guardian
contacts.description: The guardian in the prison corridor exchanges the ancient arcane rune for a mithril key. A supplied exact rune fits independently of the efreeti return; the rune’s local source needs builder integration.

contacts.name: a svirfneblin slave
contacts.description: This svirfneblin slave works in the mines. The enslaved workers form a wider story lead; meeting them does not record their liberation.

contacts.name: a troll slave
contacts.description: This troll slave works in the mines. The enslaved workers form a wider story lead; meeting them does not record their liberation.

contacts.description: This minotaur slave works in the mines. The enslaved workers form a wider story lead; meeting them does not record their liberation.

contacts.description: This drow slave works in the mines. The enslaved workers form a wider story lead; meeting them does not record their liberation.

contacts.name: a thri-kreen slave
contacts.description: This thri-kreen slave works in the mines. The enslaved workers form a wider story lead; meeting them does not record their liberation.

contacts.name: a devil slavemaster
contacts.description: The devil slavemasters oversee the mine workers. Their defeat and any lasting liberation need separate outcomes.

contacts.name: a vile demon
contacts.description: The vile demons inhabit the mines. Their encounter and equipment are separate from the two item exchanges.

contacts.name: a dangerous spectre
contacts.description: Spectres inhabit the sulfurous caverns near the prison corridor. The warning sign and these encounters are exploration leads, not an extra completed exchange.

contacts.name: Lord Kaynor, the exiled lord of Tharnadia
contacts.description: Lord Kaynor occupies the northern prison cell. The guardian’s mithril key fits that cell; access and a defined rescue or release need their own outcomes.

contacts.name: The wicked child of the Chronomancer
contacts.description: The wicked child of the Chronomancer occupies the eastern prison cell, opened by the general’s large key. Meeting the prisoner and resolving captivity are different outcomes.

contacts.name: Azurael, the lieutenant of Zariel
contacts.description: Azurael occupies the southern prison cell. Its current key reference needs builder review; an encounter does not record rescue or release.

contacts.name: a massive guardsman
contacts.description: These guardsmen follow the Minotaur general. Their battle and any recovery are separate from the efreeti and guardian returns.

contacts.name: a Minotaur general
contacts.description: The general in the forge carries the single large key and has three guardsmen followers. This key belongs to the eastern prison cell, separate from the two item exchanges.

stories.title: Bring the three lockets to the traveling efreeti
stories.summary: Gather three distinct lockets and return the complete set for a fiery wand, experience and an ethereal key. The key helps with forge access; cleansing the mines is a wider story lead.

steps.text: Carry the locket of the first loose
steps.hint: Find the overseer wearing the locket of the first. Recover or obtain this exact locket and carry it loose with the second and third lockets.

steps.text: Carry the locket of the second loose
steps.hint: Find the overseer wearing the locket of the second. A different locket or an equipped one does not prepare this part of the set.

steps.text: Carry the locket of the third loose
steps.hint: Find the overseer wearing the locket of the third. A supplied exact locket also fits; carry all three loose together.

steps.text: Record the efreeti’s accepted three-locket return
steps.hint: Bring all three distinct lockets together and offer one to the efreeti when present. The whole set is consumed for the wand, experience and ethereal key; receiving and using the rewards are later outcomes.

stories.title: Bring the ancient arcane rune to the ethereal guardian
stories.summary: Exchange the exact ancient arcane rune for the mithril key used at the northern prison cell. The rune’s source needs builder integration; a supplied exact rune remains a legal offering.

steps.text: Carry the ancient arcane rune loose
steps.hint: Carry the exact rune loose. Its local source is not declared in the reviewed zone stock; it cannot be substituted with a locket, key or brimstone shard.

steps.text: Record the guardian’s accepted rune return
steps.hint: Offer the exact rune to the guardian in the prison corridor. The exchange is independent of the efreeti return and gives a mithril key; cell access and rescue remain separate.
